net.sourceforge.zmanim.hebrewcalendar
Class HebrewDateFormatter

java.lang.Object
  net.sourceforge.zmanim.hebrewcalendar.HebrewDateFormatter

public class HebrewDateFormatter
extends Object

The HebrewDateFormatter class formats a HebrewDate. This class is part of a refactoring of Avrom Finkelstien's HebrewDate class that removes formatting code from the core HebrewDate class. TODO: add additional formatting options including Hebrew formatting support.

static String getHebrewDateAsString(HebrewDate hd)
          Returns a string containing the Hebrew date in the form, "day Month, year" e.g. "21 Shevat, 5729"
static String getHebrewMonthAsString(HebrewDate hd)
          returns a string of the current Hebrew month such as "Tishrei".
static String getOmerAsString(HebrewDate hd)
          returns a String of the Omer day in the form "Omer X" or "Lag B'Omer" or an empty string if there is no Omer this day.
